findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation "Add descriptive alt text to the informative images that lack it and empty alt to the decorative ones." lacks a specific data anchor (no selector, page URL, count).
Priority 2 recommendation "Order headings without skipping levels" is generic and not tied to any specific element or audit finding.
Priority 3 recommendation "Wrap the primary content of each page in a single <main> landmark" is a generic, copy‑paste style suggestion with no selector or page reference.

Priority 4 recommendation "Replace the obvious landmark containers (header, nav, main, footer, aside) with their semantic elements and give the remaining containers meaningful class names." lacks specific data anchors such as selectors or counts.
